name: Move all open cases
description: All Open Cases moved from the resigned primary contact to the updated primary contact

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case
WHERE account_id = 4
  AND contact_id = 2
  AND state IN ('new','in_progress','pending');

name: Update Primary Contact
description: Ensure primary contact was set correctly

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM contact
WHERE contact_id = 3
  AND is_primary = 1;

name: Transition Case Created
description: Ensure a new transition case was created

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM customer_case
WHERE account_id = 4
  AND contact_id = 3
  AND priority = 'moderate'
  AND state = 'new'
  AND channel = 'web';

name: Notification Sent to New Primary
description: Check to see that notification was sent to new primary contact

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM notification
WHERE email = 'derek.blake7@globex.com'
  AND type = 'update'
  AND case_id = (
      SELECT case_id
      FROM customer_case
      WHERE account_id = 4
        AND contact_id = 3
        AND priority = 'moderate'
        AND state = 'new'
      ORDER BY case_id DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );
